case1.description: The two PSTs of the known-data kit windows11_arm_outlook_pst_known_20261109, made with Outlook LTSC 2024 and no account on a lab VM: a Unicode PST with drafts, a moved mail, contacts, appointments, tasks, notes, journal entries and Deleted Items, and an ANSI PST with two mails and a contact. Every value was typed by the kit (kd_ names, example.com addresses). No case data.
